requirement.original: Add a RIGHT SIDEBAR panel to the app, creating a 3-panel layout: Left sidebar (existing session list) | Main chat area | Right sidebar (NEW: tool detail content). Desktop: opens on tool content click, collapsible, default collapsed, width ~40% or 400-500px. Mobile: full-screen overlay with back button.
requirement.clarified: Add a right sidebar panel for tool detail content. Desktop: 3-panel layout with collapsible right sidebar triggered by tool content click. Mobile: use existing full-screen Stack navigation (already works).
requirement.what: Right sidebar infrastructure for 3-panel desktop layout showing tool detail content
requirement.why: Allow users to view tool details side-by-side with chat without losing context by navigating away from the conversation

included: State management for sidebar open/close and selected tool
Tool content click handler modification for desktop
excluded: Mobile layout changes (existing Stack navigation suffices)

success_criteria: Desktop: clicking tool content area opens right sidebar with ToolFullView
Desktop: right sidebar can be closed, defaults to closed
Mobile: tool click still navigates to full-screen detail page
3 panels visible simultaneously on desktop >= 1200px wide
constraints: Cannot use second expo-router/drawer (only one supported)
Must work with existing expo-router Stack navigation
Must reuse existing ToolFullView component for content

root_cause_analysis.root_cause: N/A - new feature, no existing bug

research_findings.reason: Straightforward UI panel addition using established React Native patterns already present in the codebase (the left sidebar provides a clear reference implementation)

context.codebase_state: Current 2-panel layout: expo-router Drawer (permanent on tablet) for left sidebar + Stack for main content

SidebarNavigator.tsx.purpose: Manages left sidebar drawer. Uses expo-router/drawer with drawerType:'permanent' on tablet. Collapse state via useLocalSettingMutable('sidebarCollapsed'). Renders <Drawer /> inside a <View style={{flex:1}}>. Cmd+B keyboard shortcut.

SidebarView.tsx.purpose: Content of left sidebar. Shows session list header, connection status, navigation icons. Renders <MainView variant='sidebar' />.

_layout.tsx (root).purpose: Root layout. Wraps app in providers (Auth, Theme, Modal, Realtime, etc). Renders <SidebarNavigator /> as the main content tree.

_layout.tsx (app).purpose: App stack navigator. Defines all Stack.Screen entries. session/[id] has headerShown:false.

session/[id].tsx.purpose: Thin wrapper rendering <SessionView id={sessionId} />. Uses useLocalSearchParams.

ToolView.tsx.purpose: Renders individual tool call in chat. handlePress navigates to /session/{id}/message/{messageId} or calls onPress callback. Header is clickable.
ToolView.tsx.click_handler: handlePress at L35-41: if onPress callback exists, call it; else router.push to message detail page

[messageId].tsx.purpose: Full-screen tool detail page. Renders ToolFullView. Uses Stack.Screen for header. This is what mobile uses and what desktop currently uses.

ToolFullView.tsx.purpose: Full detail view of a tool call. Shows description, input params, output, and custom views. Wrapped in ScrollView with layout.container. This component should be reused in the right sidebar.

environment.responsive: useIsTablet() returns true when screen diagonal >= tablet threshold. useWindowDimensions() for reactive width.
environment.local_settings: useLocalSettingMutable() provides [value, setter] for Zustand-backed local settings. sidebarCollapsed works despite not being in LocalSettingsSchema (passthrough parsing).
environment.keyboard_shortcuts: useGlobalKeyboard hook for web shortcuts. Left sidebar uses raw addEventListener.

development_approach.strategy: 1) Create right sidebar state store (Zustand or simple context). 2) Create RightSidebar component that renders ToolFullView for the selected tool. 3) Modify SidebarNavigator to render the right sidebar as a sibling panel on desktop. 4) Modify ToolView click handler: on desktop (isTablet), open right sidebar instead of navigating; on mobile, keep existing router.push. 5) Add close button and Escape key handler.
development_approach.validation_approach: Playwright E2E: 1) Desktop viewport - click tool content, verify right sidebar appears with tool detail. 2) Close sidebar, verify it disappears. 3) Mobile viewport - click tool, verify full-screen navigation. 4) Session switch with sidebar open, verify sidebar closes.

proposed.structure: View(flex:1) > Drawer(permanent|front) > View(flex:1, flexDirection:'row') > [Slot(flex:1, minWidth:300), RightSidebar(width:400-500 or conditional)]
proposed.right_sidebar_state: Zustand store: { isOpen, sessionId, messageId, openTool(sessionId, messageId), close() }
proposed.integration_point: Best approach is to render right sidebar inside the session page layout rather than in SidebarNavigator, because it needs access to session context and tool data. SessionView.tsx wraps chat + right sidebar in a flex row on desktop.
